title: Apple's 'bad news' wasn't as bad as expected. Here's what Wall Street is saying about the iPhone giant's earnings. (AAPL)
text: Apple's 'bad news' wasn't as bad as expected. Here's what Wall Street is saying about the iPhone giant's earnings. (AAPL) By Rebecca Ungarino Jan 30, 2019, 10:19 am Wall Street analysts were reacting to Apple's quarterly earnings results on Wednesday. On Tuesday, fiscal first-quarter earnings and revenue both came in barely above analysts' estimates, and essentially in line with Apple's preannouncement earlier this month.
